resources.string: Dictation

Press the action key briefly and speak right away. Without an assigned key, tap the microphone instead. Press again to stop recording. Hans transcribes the recording and sends the finished text to your current task, including while Codex is working.
Recording stops automatically after two minutes. No Live Voice connection is opened for dictation.
Phone call
Tap Hans at the top for an ongoing conversation. Say goodbye or choose Hang up to end it.
Uses your ChatGPT sign-in and account limits. No API key needed.
